# Media test fixtures

Synthetic audio only; no third-party content.

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 | Made with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apple-he-aac-3s.m4a` | 14108 | `5eda7270a7361862fda54825527d39e5cc1788f8391fc172ebcd5c1bb0200577` | `afconvert -f m4af -d aach` |
| `apple-he-aac-v2-3s.m4a` | 13228 | `5385427ccf86594b947c357b888c6032a0c29f5c580d3a1c581fb76ca422054f` | `afconvert -f m4af -d aacp` |

Both were encoded on macOS 27.0.1 (26A434) by Apple's `afconvert` from a generated
3.00 s, 44.1 kHz, 16-bit stereo WAV: a 440 Hz sine on the left channel and a
660 Hz sine on the right, amplitude 8000. Apple's AAC encoder is not available
on other platforms, so the files are stored rather than generated by the tests.

At this duration the source's edit list includes a final padding-only packet
that the rebuilt file's edit list leaves out. `cover_art.rs` uses them to check
that M4A packet comparison ignores edit lists (ENGINE-FIX-4, F1).
